data.languages: understands Common and Elvish but can't speak
data.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Dive Attack
traits.description: If the peryton is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage to the target.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The peryton doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The peryton has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The peryton makes one gore attack and one talon attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.
